title.zh: 将曼达卢永市 Isaac Lopez 小学改设为名为 Isaac Lopez 综合学校的综合学校并为其拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Isaac Lopez Elementary School in Mandaluyong City into an Integrated School to be known as the Isaac Lopez Integrated School and appropriating funds therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Isaac Lopez Elementary School in Mandaluyong City into an Integrated School to be known as the Isaac Lopez Integrated School and appropriating funds therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2004/ra_9300_2004.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Conversion into an Integrated School. - The Isaac Lopez Elementary School in Mandaluyong City is hereby converted into an integrated school to be known as the Isaac Lopez Integrated School.
Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Isaac Lopez Elementary School are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Isaac Lopez Integrated School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Isaac Lopez Integrated School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Isaac Lopez Elementary School and thereafter in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations to implement this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
